body:
> Passwords, called "Memorized Secrets" by NIST 800-63 include passwords, PINs, unlock patterns, pick the correct kitten or another image element, and passphrases.

should have a comma after NIST 800-63, e.g., 

> Passwords, called "Memorized Secrets" by NIST 800-63, include passwords, PINs, unlock patterns, pick the correct kitten or another image element, and passphrases.
title: V2.1 - Add missing comma in first sentence
